nullable: one non-null primitive/object/array type plus null; no general type union
oneOf: only branches containing const and optional title/description; distinct scalar values
references: local components or same-origin immutable schema URI; no reference siblings; no recursive expansion
additionalProperties: false or explicit non-empty value schema; never true
annotationPolicy: title/description describe business data; no menu, component, view, layout, hidden or disabled keywords
extensionPolicy: new concrete OIT scenario, failed representation proof, decision in issue, schema fixture and inference test before protocol extension
